propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build identical nested pytest invocations with duplicated basetemp, timeout, and cache-plugin logic, creating maintenance burden and three separate CLOSED bugs

Three test sites lack --basetemp entirely (test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py, test_git_version_floor.py, test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py), causing temp directory lifecycle defects
A new run_nested_pytest helper must forward env verbatim without merge or modification to preserve security oracles in four repr-safety tests
The helper must guarantee child basetemp lives under caller's tmp_path, propagate TimeoutExpired, and return CompletedProcess by identity
All 14 launch sites must be converted while preserving per-site argument divergence (timeouts, cache flags, collect-only mode) and leaving two console-script sites unconverted
